title: Detective Conan Anime's 4th Collection of Episodes 'Clash of the Red and Black' Streams on Crunchyroll, Netflix on November 1
content: Netflix had previously teased episodes for November 1. TMS began streaming the first specially curated selection of Detective Conan episodes in July 2025 on Netflix and Crunchyroll . The episodes are streaming in Japanese and with a new English dub by Studio Nano , different from the Bang Zoom! and Funimation dubs.
author: ANN

title: Tetsuya Chiba, Ashita no Joe’s Legendary Creator, Dies at 87
content: Tetsuya Chiba, the legendary creator behind manga hits such as Ashita no Joe and more, has died at the age of 87. Kodansha has announced that the legendary creator had passed away on October 22nd at the age of 87 due to myelodysplastic syndrome, disorders that impact bone marrow, at a hospital in Tokyo.
author: ComicBook

title: GKIDS Releases cocoon Wartime Anime Digitally With Blu-ray Disc Release Shipping on January 19
content: GKIDS announced on Tuesday that it has released cocoon – One Summer of Girlhood ( cocoon Aru Natsu no Shōjo-tachi Yori ), the anime of Machiko Kyō 's Cocoon manga, digitally on Apple TV and Prime Video. The company will release the anime on Blu-ray Disc on January 19.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film's Trailer Previews supercell's Theme Song
content: Crunchyroll began streaming on Tuesday a trailer for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film , and it previews the theme song "Yoru to Ao" (Night and Blue) by supercell . The film will open in Japan on November 20.
